conviction_note: Scaled: abs_move 22 (name's own median reaction 24.4%, no usable chain, small cap, guide likely discussed) x p_up 46 = -1.76. The lean comes from public arithmetic: the FY26 $90-92m guide needs an H2 acceleration to +6-10% YoY with China at zero, and the street already sits at the low end. Against that are an easy Q3 comp, a covenant with headroom and low short interest. The findings sum to -2.0 and the scaled number is close to it; neither is large because the key fact is guide math the market can do itself, not an unpriced number.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue about $22.0m, per Earnings Whispers (https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/lung); a second EW page shows $22.76m, which looks stale (it equals the Q2 actual). EPS consensus about -$0.26. The bar is therefore single-source and capped. FY26 bar: company guide $90-92m, reiterated 2026-07-29 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001127537/000112753726000035/lung2q26earningsrelease072.htm). Analyst FY consensus about $90.5m (Simply Wall St summary, post-Q2), i.e. the low end of the guide.
positioning_check: Short interest 698.6K shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, down from 802.7K; days to cover 2.54 on about 275K ADV (https://www.optionsanalysissuite.com/stocks/lung/short-interest). That is about 1.6% of the 42.95m shares outstanding (10-Q cover). The same aggregator showed 3.6M shares short at 2026-04-30, so shorts have largely covered. This is not a crowded short and there is little squeeze fuel. Skew: none; the option chain is unusable (26 contracts of open interest, ATM not two-sided). Tape: spot $1.975, +8.5% over 5 days, -0.25% over 20 days, -24% from the 52-week high, +69% off the 52-week low. Market cap about $85m against $55.8m cash and $40.3m Perceptive debt (EV about $70m, about 0.8x sales).

findings.finding: The FY26 revenue guide of $90-92m (reiterated 2026-07-29) needs H2 revenue of $46.7-48.7m: H1 was $43.3m ($20.6m Q1 + $22.8m Q2, 10-Q). That is +6-10% YoY against H2 2025's $44.1m ($21.5m Q3 + $22.6m Q4), after H1 fell 6.7% YoY, and China shipments stay at zero until early 2027 (10-Q). With the Q3 bar at about $22.0m, Q4 would need about $24.7-26.7m, a record quarter. A trim of the guide to about $88-90m tonight is a live risk. Street FY about $90.5m is already at the low end, so a modest trim is partly expected; a cut below $88m is not.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance moves this stock violently. 2025-07-30 (FY25 guide cut): -41.6%. 2025-11-12 (FY25 lowered to $89-90m): -18.9%. 2025-10-27 (preliminary Q3 plus a management transition): +26.9%. 2026-07-29 (guide held, small beat): +28.8%, which shows that simply holding the guide was rewarded.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The stock trades at about 0.8x EV/sales and the street sits at the low end of the guide. If a cut were fully priced, consensus FY would sit below $90m and the stock would not have run up 8.5% in the five days into the print. If it were not priced at all, analysts would sit at mid-guide. The +28.8% reaction to merely holding the guide in July says holders treat the guide as live, so a cut would be news.
findings.independence: The Q4 2025 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1127537/000112753726000003/lung4q25earningsrelease030.htm) gives Q4 2025 at $22.6m with US -11% YoY, which sets the H2 comp. Same company documents, one arithmetic.

findings.finding: The Q3 2026 comp is easy and the US trend is improving. Q3 2025 revenue was $21.5m (US $14.0m, intl $7.5m incl. China). Q2 2026 US revenue was $14.2m, +7% sequentially, with SG&A down and the US sales leadership 'fully staffed'. Q1 intl ex-China grew +22% YoY. Against a single-source ~$22.0m bar (+2.3% YoY, -3.5% QoQ, consistent with normal Q3 seasonality: Q3 2025 was -10% QoQ), an in-line to slight beat is the base case. Management said on the Q2 call it expected a return to YoY growth later in 2026 despite Q3 seasonality.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue of $22.76m against $22.39m (+1.6% beat) with the guide held: +28.8%. Q1 2026 ($20.6m, -9% YoY): +6.7%. Small revenue beats have been bought when the guide held.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. The consensus is thin (about 5 analysts) and the bar itself is uncertain ($22.0m vs a stale $22.76m). If the market expected a clear beat, the stock would not sit near $2 with -0.25% over 20 days. The +8.5% five-day run-up suggests some is anticipated.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 10-Q geographic table (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001127537/000112753726000039/lung-20260630.htm): US $14.18m vs $14.73m, intl $8.58m vs $9.13m. A different document from the Q3 2025 release, but the same company source.

findings.finding: The balance sheet removes a financing or covenant scare from this print. The Perceptive credit agreement's minimum TTM revenue covenant is flat at $85.0m for every quarter through 2028-12-31 (Exhibit 10.1, Section 10.02), against TTM revenue of $87.4m at Q2. TTM at Q3 stays about $88m even if Q3 merely matches $21.5m. Cash was $55.8m at June 30 against a minimum liquidity of $4m, Q2 burn was about $5.8m, the FY cash-use guide is about $23m, and the opex guide was cut to $109-111m from $113-115m. No ATM agreement was found on EDGAR and there has been no 8-K since July 29.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned on financing. The March 2026 refinancing came with the Q4 print (+11.8%).
findings.why_not_priced: The covenant schedule sits only in the credit agreement exhibit. The 10-Q gives just the $85.0m and $107.5m endpoints, which reads as if steps could bite in 2026. A market worried about a covenant step would show it as a discount on a ~0.8x-sales name. This is covenant arithmetic, so it is kept small.
findings.independence: Q2 release outlook (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001127537/000112753726000035/lung2q26earningsrelease072.htm): opex guide lowered and cash-use guide held at about $23m. A different document.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with (unusable chain). The 5-day run-up of +8.5% into the print cuts mildly against a positive surprise, and the mild negative guide lean runs with the stock's -24% distance from the 52-week high. Low short interest means no squeeze offset to a negative.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar single-source and disputed, $22.0m vs a stale $22.76m): the reported-quarter finding is capped, +1.5 to +1.0.
'What worked' section (covenant arithmetic is not a document-level unpriced number): the covenant/financing finding is cut, +1.0 to +0.5.
Rule 1 and the pessimism artefact (guide math is public and the street is at the low end; the July hold was bought +28.8%): the guidance finding is shrunk, -4.0 to -3.5.
Rule 7: short interest was checked before the negative; it is low (2.5 DTC), so there is no squeeze shrink. abs_move and p_up are unchanged.
